key_insight: VaDar uses subgoal-specific critics to train one subgoal-independent policy, eliminating explicit subgoal selection at deployment.
engineering_relevance: For long-horizon robotic tasks, VaDar can simplify deployment by moving subgoal handling into training rather than requiring a runtime subgoal selector.
method: Train a single policy to maximize a linear combination of those values.
Deploy the policy without subgoal inputs or explicit subgoal selection.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports competitive or better performance than goal-conditioning baselines, success on non-sequential and multi-objective tasks, and the first algorithm to solve challenging long-horizon RoboCasa tasks, including from behavior-cloned policies with near-zero initial task success.
watch_item: Training still requires subgoal information and per-subgoal critics; the abstract does not quantify annotation costs or sensitivity to critic-combination weights.
paper_title: VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation
